## Study description


In each of 5 reps 25 1/20 acre circular plots were planted with 34 1-0 (1 year old) Douglas fir seedlings. 5 plots per rep were  each assigned to a treatment: DF0Y, RA10Y, CW10Y, RA20Y, CW20Y. (plots = 125, tmt = 5, rep = 5, plots/tmt/rep = 5). 34 seedlings/plot = approx 4,250 trees.   

## Loading libraries

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Importing data
Two multi-sheet workboooks were provided by Anna Leon of Weyerhauser (Anna.Leon@weyerhaeuser.com). One with keys for metadata codes and one with coded data plus a dictionary for column names

Also recieve raw datasheets which were transcribed into Excell and imported.

Jan 2022 received additional digital data from John Browning. Contains 1995 and 2011 measurements for plots A B and C. As well as stem maps for A and B. The fields for this data are somewhat different and include a field called "Dead year". Sheet 1 Data range B2:K2214

NOTE: Lab computer path "showalt_d/", home computer "showa/"

## Combining new and old datasets

```{r, message=FALSE}

#attempting to combine new_combined_data (transcribed) and combined_data (excell sheet from Anna)

small_keep<-c("DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","DIA_11_mm","STS_87","STS_95","STS_11","DAM1","Dead_YEAR","Tree_ID")
new_combined_data_small<-as.data.frame(new_combined_data[,(colnames(new_combined_data) %in% small_keep)])

#combined_data$Dead_YEAR<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$DIA_87_mm<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$HT_87<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$DIA_95_mm<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$HT_95<-as.character(NA)
#combined_data$DIA_11_mm<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$HT_11<-as.character(NA)
#combined_data$STS_87<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$STS_95<-as.double(NA)
#combined_data$STS_11<-as.double(NA)



test<-merge.data.frame(new_combined_data_small, combined_data, by= "Tree_ID", all.y = TRUE)
# checking for instances when DIA_11_mm and ODBH (supposedly 2011) are more than 15 mm different
# making a flag. Counding the flags. Subsetting the data for flags.
test$DBH_diff<-(test$ODBH - test$DIA_11_mm)
test$dbh_flag<- ifelse(abs(test$DBH_diff) >15,TRUE,FALSE)
flag_count<-sum(test$dbh_flag, na.rm=TRUE)
flag_count
DBH_flags<-as.data.frame(test[which(test$dbh_flag==TRUE),c("Tree_ID","DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","STS_11","OSTS","DIA_11_mm","ODBH","NDBH","DBH_diff","dbh_flag")])

# renaming
full_data<- as.data.frame(test)

# checking when STS_11 and OSTS don't match, as with diameter above.

full_data$STS_flag <- ifelse(full_data$STS_11!=full_data$OSTS, TRUE, FALSE)
STS_flags<-as.data.frame(full_data[which(full_data$STS_flag==TRUE),c("Tree_ID","STS_87","STS_95","STS_11","OSTS","NSTS","DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","DIA_11_mm","ODBH","NDBH")])
STS_flag_count<-sum(full_data$STS_flag, na.rm=TRUE)
STS_flag_count

# subsetting to when STS_11=1 and separately when NSTS=1 
STS_flags_1<-as.data.frame(STS_flags[which(STS_flags$STS_11==1),])
STS_flags_2<-as.data.frame(STS_flags[which(STS_flags$NSTS==1),])

# calculating differences in ODBH and NDBH to identify possible Dead trees that didn't grow between the 2 measurements
full_data$new_dia_diff<-(full_data$NDBH - full_data$ODBH)
full_data$nd_dif_flag<- ifelse(
  (
    abs(full_data$new_dia_diff) 
    < 5 
     ),1,0)
nd_dif_flag_count<-sum(full_data$nd_dif_flag, na.rm=TRUE)
nd_dif_flag_count
# subsetting this data to trees which have OSTS or NSTS =1 contradicting their living status
DIA_diff_sts<-as.data.frame(full_data[which((full_data$nd_dif_flag==1) & (full_data$NSTS=="1")),c("Tree_ID","STS_87","STS_95","STS_11","OSTS","NSTS","DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","DIA_11_mm","ODBH","NDBH")])

# checking for trees with ODBH greater than 5 mm larger than NDBH   #there are none
#oops<-full_data[which(full_data$ODBH > (full_data$NDBH + 5)),"Tree_ID"]

#Using ODBH values for missing DIA_11_mm values

full_data$DBH_11<-ifelse(is.na(full_data$DIA_11_mm),full_data$ODBH,full_data$DIA_11_mm)

#and for status values

full_data$STS_2011<-ifelse(is.na(full_data$STS_11),full_data$OSTS,full_data$STS_11)
ABC<- full_data[full_data$TRT=="RA10Y"|full_data$TRT=="CW10Y"|full_data$TRT=="DF0Y",]

#write.csv(full_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/full_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#saveRDS(full_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/raw_data/full_data.Rds")

```

## Remaining questions
Note says that DF tretament "C" was 45 years old in 2020.Thus, plots were established in 1975.  All treatments were started at the same time follwing clearcut. DF in 10 year roation treatments are 35 (45-10) years old and in 20 year treatments 25 (45-20) years old.


Mike indicated that there were 34 trees planted in each of the circular observation subplots.

To what year(s) do(es) the "old" measurements in the provided data refer?
mean DBH of 20y rotations for "ODBH" old dbh is 7-9cm, so maybe 2010 when the doug firs would have been ~15 yo
Anna confirmed that the "old" measurements refer to 2011.

If this is the case, could we recode the measurements in terms of DF age? So assuming 2010 old DBH for DF0y would be 35Y, old DBH for 10y trts would be 25Y, for 20y trts would be 15y. New (2020) DBH for DF0y would be 45Y, old DBH for 10y trts would be 35Y, for 20y trts would be 25y. Could create this variable as "DF_age" with data in long format? This is done below.

Are there any additional useful maps? Anna? Mike? Do we have coordinates or GIS objects for plot Centers

11 trees without NDBH measurements. Are they duplicated in other plots? Remove them? No, they are Dead (or one fused trunk).

Randomization/exp design.  RCB?
Is there a stem map and/or do the tree numbers refer to a position in the subplot?

```{r}
#pivot to long data by old and new
#pivoting data from wide to long format

#checking similary of column types before combining

#as.character  Tree_ID TREE LASTTREE  STS_87 STS_95  STS_11 STS_2011 OSTS  NSTS  DAM1.x(2011) DAM1.y(2020)
full_data$Tree_ID<-as.character(full_data$Tree_ID)
full_data$TREE<-as.character(full_data$TREE)
full_data$LASTTREE<-as.character(full_data$LASTTREE)
full_data$STS_87<-as.character(full_data$STS_87)
full_data$STS_95<-as.character(full_data$STS_95)
full_data$STS_11<-as.character(full_data$STS_11)
full_data$STS_2011<-as.character(full_data$STS_2011)
full_data$OSTS<-as.character(full_data$OSTS)
full_data$NSTS<-as.character(full_data$NSTS)
full_data$DAM1.x<-as.character(full_data$DAM1.x)
full_data$DAM1.y<-as.character(full_data$DAM1.y)

#as.double DIA_87_mm  DIA_97_mm DIA_11_mm DBH_11 ODBH NDBH
full_data$DIA_87_mm<-as.double(full_data$DIA_87_mm)
full_data$DIA_95_mm<-as.double(full_data$DIA_95_mm)
full_data$DIA_11_mm<-as.double(full_data$DIA_11_mm)
full_data$DBH_11<-as.double(full_data$DBH_11)
full_data$ODBH<-as.double(full_data$ODBH)
full_data$NDBH<-as.double(full_data$NDBH)

#as.factor PLOT REP SUBPLOT TRT TRT_code  SUBPLOT_ID
full_data$PLOT<-as.factor(full_data$PLOT)
full_data$REP<-as.factor(full_data$REP)
full_data$SUBPLOT<-as.factor(full_data$SUBPLOT)
full_data$TRT<-as.factor(full_data$TRT)
full_data$TRT_code<-as.factor(full_data$TRT_code)
full_data$SUBPLOT_ID<-as.factor(full_data$SUBPLOT_ID)


#for diameters
#long_data<- pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("ODBH","NDBH"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DBH_mm")
long_data<- pivot_longer(full_data, cols = c("DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","DBH_11","NDBH"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DBH_mm")
#for status
#status<-pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("OSTS","NSTS"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "STATUS")
status<-pivot_longer(full_data, cols = c("STS_87","STS_95","STS_2011","NSTS"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "STATUS")

#for height
#height<-pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("OHT","NHT"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "HEIGHT")
#for damage code with dummy variable for  because the data was not taken
#combined_data$ODAM1<-NA
#damage<-pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("ODAM1","DAM1"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DAM")

#for 2011 and 2020 damage codes with dummy variables for 87 95 because the status was not recorded in those years
full_data$DAM87<-NA
full_data$DAM95<-NA
damage<-pivot_longer(full_data, cols = c("DAM87","DAM95","DAM1.x","DAM1.y"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DAM")

#combining
long_data$STATUS<-as.character(status$STATUS)
#long_data$HEIGHT<-as.character(height$HEIGHT)
long_data$DAMAGE<-as.character(damage$DAM)

#replacing numbers for "YEAR" and also adding a "YEAR" factor variable
long_data$YEAR_dbl<-as.double(ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="DIA_87_mm", 1987,
                                     ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="DIA_95_mm", 1995,
                                            ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="DBH_11", 2011,
                                                   ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="NDBH", 2020, NA)))))
long_data$YEAR_fac<-as.factor(long_data$YEAR_dbl)

#making descriptive status variable
long_data$Tree_status<-as.character(ifelse(long_data$STATUS=="1", "Alive",
                                     ifelse(long_data$STATUS=="3", "Dead", NA)))

#and a suppression flag
long_data$SUPP<-as.character(ifelse(long_data$DAMAGE=="400", "SUPP", NA))

#and a root rot flag
long_data$ROOT<-as.character(ifelse((long_data$DAMAGE=="806"|long_data$DAMAGE=="807"|long_data$DAMAGE=="808"), "ROT", NA))
                                     
#making live basal area calculation for each tree using status and diameter
long_data$Live_BA_sq_m<-as.double(ifelse(long_data$STATUS=="1", (3.14159*((long_data$DBH_mm / 2000)^2)) ,NA))

#creating DF_age variable based on treatment and estimated measurement year
#long_data$DF_age<-as.numeric(ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="ODBH", #if old
#                ifelse(long_data$TRT=="RA20Y"|long_data$TRT=="CW20Y",16, #if 20Y
#                      ifelse(long_data$TRT=="DF0Y",36 #if 0Y
#                          , 26)) #else/ if 10Y
#          , #else/ if new
#                ifelse(long_data$TRT=="RA20Y"|long_data$TRT=="CW20Y",25, #if 20Y
#                      ifelse(long_data$TRT=="DF0Y",45 #if 0Y
#                          , 35)))) #else/ if 10Y

#####FIXED

long_data$DF_age<-NA
long_data$DF_age<-as.numeric(
  ifelse( long_data$YEAR=="NDBH" #test 2020
            , #yes 2020
          ifelse((long_data$TRT=="RA20Y" | long_data$TRT=="CW20Y") #test 20Y
            , 25  #yes 20Y
            , #no 20Y
            ifelse((long_data$TRT=="RA10Y" | long_data$TRT=="CW10Y") #test 10y
              , 35  #yes 10Y
              , 45 #no 10Y 
            )# TRT 10 test close
          ) #TRT 20 test Close
          , #no 2020
          ifelse( long_data$YEAR=="DBH_11",  #test 2011
          ifelse( #yes 2011
          (long_data$TRT=="RA20Y" | long_data$TRT=="CW20Y"), # test 20Y
          16 #yes 20y
          , #no 20 y
          ifelse((long_data$TRT=="RA10Y" | long_data$TRT=="CW10Y"), #test 10y
                 26, #yes 10y
                 36) #no 10Y therefore DF
          ) #close 20y test
          , #no 2011
  ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="DIA_95_mm", #test 95
        ifelse( #yes 95
          (long_data$TRT=="RA10Y" | long_data$TRT=="CW10Y"), #test 10YTRT
          10, #yes 10Y TRT
          NA #no 10Y TRT (and therefore not sampled in 1995)
          )   #close TRT test
         , #no 95
  ifelse(long_data$YEAR=="DIA_87_mm", #test 87
         ifelse( #yes 87
           long_data$TRT=="DF0Y", #test DF
           12, #yes DF
           NA), #no DF (and therefore no to all treatments)
  NA #no 87 (and therefor no to all dates)
  ) # 87 close
  ) # 95 close
  ) # 11 close
  ) # 2020 close
) #numeric close

#subsetting to keep only relevant columns

keep_cols<- c("Tree_ID","TREE","PLOT","REP","SUBPLOT","SUBPLOT_ID","TRT","TRT_code","YEAR_fac","YEAR_dbl","DF_age","Tree_status","DBH_mm","Live_BA_sq_m","STATUS","DAMAGE", "SUPP", "ROOT")
long_data_keep<-long_data[,names(long_data) %in% keep_cols]
long_data_keep<-long_data_keep[,keep_cols]
```

## Converting to long data format for just ABC trts
```{r}
#pivot to long data by old and new
#pivoting data from wide to long format

#checking similary of column types before combining
#glimpse(ABC)
#as.character  Tree_ID TREE LASTTREE  STS_87 STS_95  STS_11 STS_2011 OSTS  NSTS  DAM1.x(2011) DAM1.y(2020)

ABC$STS_95<-as.character(ABC$STS_95)

ABC$STS_2011<-as.character(ABC$STS_2011)

ABC$NSTS<-as.character(ABC$NSTS)

#as.double DIA_87_mm  DIA_97_mm DIA_11_mm DBH_11 ODBH NDBH
ABC$DIA_87_mm<-as.double(ABC$DIA_87_mm)
ABC$DIA_95_mm<-as.double(ABC$DIA_95_mm)

ABC$DBH_11<-as.double(ABC$DBH_11)
ABC$ODBH<-as.double(ABC$ODBH)
ABC$NDBH<-as.double(ABC$NDBH)

#as.factor PLOT REP SUBPLOT TRT TRT_code  SUBPLOT_ID

#for diameters
#ABC_long<- pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("ODBH","NDBH"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DBH_mm")
ABC_long<- pivot_longer(ABC, cols = c("DIA_87_mm","DIA_95_mm","DBH_11","NDBH"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DBH_mm")
#for status
#status<-pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("OSTS","NSTS"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "STATUS")
status_ABC<-pivot_longer(ABC, cols = c("STS_87","STS_95","STS_2011","NSTS"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "STATUS")

#for height
#height<-pivot_longer(combined_data, cols = c("OHT","NHT"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "HEIGHT")
#for damage code with dummy variable for  because the data was not taken

#for 2011 and 2020 damage codes with dummy variables for 87 95 because the status was not recorded in those years
ABC$DAM87<-NA
ABC$DAM95<-NA
damage_ABC<-pivot_longer(ABC, cols = c("DAM87","DAM95","DAM1.x","DAM1.y"), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "DAM")

#combining
ABC_long$STATUS<-as.character(status_ABC$STATUS)
#ABC_long$HEIGHT<-as.character(height$HEIGHT)
ABC_long$DAMAGE<-as.character(damage_ABC$DAM)

#replacing numbers for "YEAR" and also adding a "YEAR" factor variable
ABC_long$YEAR_dbl<-as.double(ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="DIA_87_mm", 1987,
                                     ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="DIA_95_mm", 1995,
                                            ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="DBH_11", 2011,
                                                   ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="NDBH", 2020, NA)))))
ABC_long$YEAR_fac<-as.factor(ABC_long$YEAR_dbl)

#making descriptive status variable
ABC_long$Tree_status<-as.character(ifelse(ABC_long$STATUS=="1", "Alive",
                                     ifelse(ABC_long$STATUS=="3", "Dead", NA)))

#and a suppression flag
ABC_long$SUPP<-as.character(ifelse(ABC_long$DAMAGE=="400", "SUPP", NA))

#and a root rot flag
ABC_long$ROOT<-as.character(ifelse((ABC_long$DAMAGE=="806"|ABC_long$DAMAGE=="807"|ABC_long$DAMAGE=="808"), "ROT", NA))
                                     
#making live basal area calculation for each tree using status and diameter
#convert from mm diameter to m radius, square, times pi 
ABC_long$Live_BA_sq_m<-as.double(ifelse(ABC_long$STATUS=="1", (3.14159*((ABC_long$DBH_mm / 2000)^2)) ,NA))

#creating DF_age variable based on treatment and estimated measurement year

ABC_long$DF_age<-NA
ABC_long$DF_age<-as.numeric(
  ifelse( ABC_long$YEAR=="NDBH" #test 2020
            , #yes 2020
          ifelse((ABC_long$TRT=="RA20Y" | ABC_long$TRT=="CW20Y") #test 20Y
            , 25  #yes 20Y
            , #no 20Y
            ifelse((ABC_long$TRT=="RA10Y" | ABC_long$TRT=="CW10Y") #test 10y
              , 35  #yes 10Y
              , 45 #no 10Y 
            )# TRT 10 test close
          ) #TRT 20 test Close
          , #no 2020
          ifelse( ABC_long$YEAR=="DBH_11",  #test 2011
          ifelse( #yes 2011
          (ABC_long$TRT=="RA20Y" | ABC_long$TRT=="CW20Y"), # test 20Y
          16 #yes 20y
          , #no 20 y
          ifelse((ABC_long$TRT=="RA10Y" | ABC_long$TRT=="CW10Y"), #test 10y
                 26, #yes 10y
                 36) #no 10Y therefore DF
          ) #close 20y test
          , #no 2011
  ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="DIA_95_mm", #test 95
        ifelse( #yes 95
          (ABC_long$TRT=="RA10Y" | ABC_long$TRT=="CW10Y"), #test 10YTRT
          10, #yes 10Y TRT
          NA #no 10Y TRT (and therefore not sampled in 1995)
          )   #close TRT test
         , #no 95
  ifelse(ABC_long$YEAR=="DIA_87_mm", #test 87
         ifelse( #yes 87
           ABC_long$TRT=="DF0Y", #test DF
           12, #yes DF
           NA), #no DF (and therefore no to all treatments)
  NA #no 87 (and therefor no to all dates)
  ) # 87 close
  ) # 95 close
  ) # 11 close
  ) # 2020 close
) #numeric close

#making FVS_age varaible using the first measurement year as 0. So for A&B trts FVS_age= DF_age - 10, C trt FVS_age= DF_age - 12.
ABC_long$FVS_age<-NA
ABC_long$FVS_age<-as.numeric(ifelse(ABC_long$TRT=="DF0Y", ABC_long$DF_age - 12, ABC_long$DF_age - 10))

#subsetting to keep only relevant columns

keep_cols_ABC<- c("Tree_ID","TREE","PLOT","REP","SUBPLOT","SUBPLOT_ID","TRT","TRT_code","YEAR_fac","YEAR_dbl","DF_age","Tree_status","DBH_mm","Live_BA_sq_m","STATUS","DAMAGE", "SUPP", "ROOT","FVS_age")
ABC_long_keep<-ABC_long[,names(ABC_long) %in% keep_cols_ABC]
ABC_long_keep<-ABC_long_keep[,keep_cols_ABC]
```

## Rep and Subplot summaries for RA10Y

```{r}
#make varible containing total counts of trees with diameters
median_dbh_Alive<-subset(RA10, Tree_status=="Alive") %>% 
  group_by(DF_age, REP, Tree_status) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
median_dbh_Dead<-subset(RA10, Tree_status=="Dead") %>% 
  group_by(DF_age, REP, Tree_status) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
pRA10<- subset(RA10, !is.na(Tree_status)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(DBH_mm,fill=Tree_status))+
  geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=0.65, binwidth =25)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.33, end = 0.99)+
  labs(title= "Size distrubtion of trees in RA10 Treatment by Age and Rep",x="DBH (mm)",y= "Trees") +
  geom_label(data = median_dbh_Alive,aes(x=Median+200,y=88,label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), alpha=0.05),  show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+
  geom_label(data = median_dbh_Dead,aes(x=55,y=88, label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), fontface='italic', alpha=0.05), show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+ 
  geom_vline(data=median_dbh_Dead,aes(xintercept=Median), linetype=2, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_vline(data=median_dbh_Alive,aes(xintercept=Median), alpha=0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  facet_grid(rows=vars(DF_age),vars(REP), labeller = label_both)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,20,40,60,80,100),limits=c(0,100))+
  xlim(0,600)+
  theme_bw()
pRA10
```

```{r}
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
medCW10_3Dead<-subset(CW10_R3, Tree_status=="Dead") %>% 
  group_by(DF_age, SUBPLOT, Tree_status) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
pCW10_3<- subset(CW10_R3, !is.na(Tree_status)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(DBH_mm,fill=Tree_status))+
  geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=0.65, binwidth=25, )+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.33, end = 0.99)+
  labs(title= "Size distrubtion of trees in CW10 Rep 3 by Age and Subplot",x="DBH (mm)",y= "Trees") +
  geom_label(data = medCW10_3Alive,aes(x=Median+200,y=25,label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), alpha=0.05),  show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+
  geom_label(data = medCW10_3Dead,aes(x=55,y=25, label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), fontface='italic', alpha=0.05), show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+ 
  geom_vline(data=medCW10_3Dead,aes(xintercept=Median), linetype=2, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_vline(data=medCW10_3Alive,aes(xintercept=Median), alpha=0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  facet_grid(rows=vars(DF_age),vars(SUBPLOT), labeller = label_both)+
  ylim(0,30)+
  xlim(0,600)+
  theme_bw()
pCW10_3
#ggsave("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Summary_Graphs/CW10_Rep3_DBH_histos_by_age_and_subplot.pdf", height= 10, width = 12, units="in")

  geom_label(data = medCW10_4Dead,aes(x=55,y=25, label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), fontface='italic', alpha=0.05), show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+ 
  geom_vline(data=medCW10_4Dead,aes(xintercept=Median), linetype=2, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_vline(data=medCW10_4Alive,aes(xintercept=Median), alpha=0.5)+
```

```{r}
medDF0_Alive<-subset(DF0, Tree_status=="Alive") %>% 
  group_by(DF_age, REP, Tree_status) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
medDF0_Dead<-subset(DF0, Tree_status=="Dead") %>% 
  group_by(DF_age, REP, Tree_status) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DBH_mm, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
pDF0<- subset(DF0, !is.na(Tree_status)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(DBH_mm,fill=Tree_status))+
  geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=0.65, binwidth =25)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.33, end = 0.99)+
  labs(title= "Size distrubtion of trees in DF0 Treatment by Age and Rep",x="DBH (mm)",y= "Trees") +
  geom_label(data = medDF0_Alive,aes(x=Median+200,y=88,label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), alpha=0.05),  show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+
  geom_label(data = medDF0_Dead,aes(x=55,y=88, label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"mm"), fontface='italic', alpha=0.05), show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+ 
  geom_vline(data=medDF0_Dead,aes(xintercept=Median), linetype=2, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_vline(data=medDF0_Alive,aes(xintercept=Median), alpha=0.5)+
```

## Generating Plot and Stand level summaries
```{r}
#building from Woods Creek approach

#creating unique tree ID variable of format TRT_REP_SUBPLOT_TREE
long_data_keep$Tree_ID_TRS<-paste(long_data_keep$TRT_code,long_data_keep$REP,long_data_keep$SUBPLOT,long_data_keep$TREE, sep = "_")
#creating unique subplotplot ID factor varaible of format TRT_REP_SUBPLOT
long_data_keep$Subplot_ID_TRS<-as.factor(paste(long_data_keep$TRT_code,long_data_keep$REP,long_data_keep$SUBPLOT, sep = "_"))

#creating subplot level DF excluding trees with no status recorded (like 1987 measurements for ABDE and 1995 for CDE)
#sources for: 
  #removing STATUS=NA https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29501188/dplyr-removing-nas-from-group-by-variable 
  #excluding Live_BA_sq_m = 0 https://stackoverflow.com/questions/54805570/dplyr-summarise-keep-na-if-all-summarised-values-are-na/54805923
#subplot_df<-long_data_keep %>% filter(!is.na(STATUS)) %>% group_by(Subplot_ID_TRS, YEAR_fac,TRT, STATUS, .drop = TRUE) %>% summarise(count = n(), Live_BA_sq_m = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_sq_m))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_sq_m, na.rm=TRUE))
#using DF age instead of year
subplot_df_age<-long_data_keep %>% filter(!is.na(STATUS)) %>% group_by(Subplot_ID_TRS, DF_age,TRT, STATUS, .drop = TRUE) %>% summarise(count = n(), Live_BA_sq_m = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_sq_m))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_sq_m, na.rm=TRUE))

# correcting subplot-level Live-BA to include area sampled (ha)
# subplots have 27' radius = 1/20 or 0.053 acre = 0.021448339 hectare
subplot_df_age$Live_BA_mpha<-subplot_df_age$Live_BA_sq_m/0.021448339

# 1 sq m = 10.7639 sq ft
subplot_df_age$Live_BA_sq_ft<-subplot_df_age$Live_BA_sq_m*10.7639
subplot_df_age$Live_BA_fpa<-subplot_df_age$Live_BA_sq_ft/.053


#adding the separate TMT, BLOCK, and PLOT columns
subplot_df_age<-subplot_df_age %>% separate(Subplot_ID_TRS, c("TRT","REP","SUBPLOT"),"_",remove = FALSE)
subplot_df_age$TRT<-as.factor(subplot_df_age$TRT)
subplot_df_age$REP<-as.factor(subplot_df_age$REP)
subplot_df_age$SUBPLOT<-as.factor(subplot_df_age$SUBPLOT)

#creating unique stand ID factor varaible of format TRT_BLOCK
subplot_df_age$Stand_ID_TR<-as.factor(paste(subplot_df_age$TRT,subplot_df_age$REP, sep = "_"))
# updating to calculate stand-level Live-BA mph and fpa by taking the mean of subplots rather than summing so I can account for missing data/subplots

stand_df_age<- subplot_df_age %>% filter(!is.na(STATUS)) %>% group_by(Stand_ID_TR, DF_age, TRT, STATUS, .drop = TRUE) %>% summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE), sum_Live_BA_sq_m = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_sq_m))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_sq_m, na.rm=TRUE), Live_BA_mpha = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_mpha))) NA_real_ else mean(Live_BA_mpha, na.rm=TRUE), sum_Live_BA_sq_ft = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_sq_ft))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_sq_ft, na.rm=TRUE), Live_BA_fpa = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_fpa))) NA_real_ else mean(Live_BA_fpa, na.rm=TRUE))

#adding the separate REP column
stand_df_age<-stand_df_age %>% separate(Stand_ID_TR, c(NA,"REP"),"_",remove = FALSE)
stand_df_age$REP<-as.factor(stand_df_age$REP)

subplot_ABC<- subplot_df_age[subplot_df_age$TRT=="A"|subplot_df_age$TRT=="B"|subplot_df_age$TRT=="C",]
stand_ABC<- stand_df_age[stand_df_age$TRT=="A"|stand_df_age$TRT=="B"|stand_df_age$TRT=="C",]

#write_rds(subplot_df_age,"C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/subplot_df_age.Rds")
#write_rds(stand_df_age,"C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/stand_level_df_age.Rds")
#write_rds(subplot_ABC,"C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/subplot_level_ABC.Rds")
#write_rds(stand_a=ABC,"C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/stand_level_ABC.Rds")

#write_csv(subplot_df_age, "C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/subplot_df_age.csv")
#write_csv(stand_df_age, "C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/stand_df_age.csv")
```

##Try linear regression with live BA or prop mortality by DF year. Multiplot and compare slope

COPIED FROM WOODS CREEK STATISTICAL ANALYSIS

```{r}
#stand_df <- readRDS("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/stand_level_df.Rds")
#generate data subset for ANOVA
AOV_in<-stand_ABC
AOV_Alive<-subset(AOV_in, AOV_in$STATUS==1)
AOV_Alive_count<- AOV_Alive %>% group_by(Stand_ID_TR, DF_age)%>%summarise(Alive=sum(count, na.rm=TRUE), Live_BA_mpha = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_mpha))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_mpha, na.rm=TRUE))
AOV_Dead<-subset(AOV_in, AOV_in$STATUS==3)
AOV_Dead_count<- AOV_Dead %>% group_by(Stand_ID_TR, DF_age)%>%summarise(Dead=sum(count, na.rm=TRUE), Live_BA_mpha = if(all(is.na(Live_BA_mpha))) NA_real_ else sum(Live_BA_mpha, na.rm=TRUE)) 

#attempt to merge datasets but there are not "Dead" entries for all of the stand/year combinations
#need to add rows for stand years with zero Dead trees https://www.statology.org/r-append-to-data-frame/
Dead_add<-data.frame("Stand_ID_TR"=c("B_2", "B_3", "B_4"),
                     "DF_age"=c(10, 10, 10),
                     "Dead"=c(0, 0, 0),
                     "Live_BA_mpha"=c(NA,NA, NA))

Dead_add$Stand_ID_TR<-as.factor(Dead_add$Stand_ID_TR)
Dead_add$DF_age<-as.double(Dead_add$DF_age)
Dead_add$Dead<-as.integer(Dead_add$Dead)
Dead_add$Live_BA_mpha<-as.double(Dead_add$Live_BA_mpha)
AOV_Dead_count_add<-rbind(AOV_Dead_count, Dead_add)
#need to have rows in same order to cbind
AOV_Dead_count_add_sort<-AOV_Dead_count_add[c(1:19,41,20,21,42,22,23,43,24:40),]
AOV_prop_Dead<-cbind(AOV_Alive_count, AOV_Dead_count_add_sort[,"Dead"])
AOV_prop_Dead$total<-(AOV_prop_Dead$Alive+AOV_prop_Dead$Dead)
AOV_prop_Dead$prop_Dead<-(AOV_prop_Dead$Dead/AOV_prop_Dead$total)
AOV_prop_Dead$prop_D_miss<-((pmax(AOV_prop_Dead$total,170)-AOV_prop_Dead$Alive)/pmax(AOV_prop_Dead$total,170))
AOV_prop_Dead$prop_Alive<-1-AOV_prop_Dead$prop_Dead
AOV_prop_Dead$prop_A_miss<-1-AOV_prop_Dead$prop_D_miss

#add unique block and tmt designations and make them factors
AOV_prop_Dead<-AOV_prop_Dead %>% separate(Stand_ID_TR, c("TRT","REP"),"_",remove = FALSE)
#AOV_prop_Dead$TRT<-as.factor(AOV_prop_Dead$TRT)
#AOV_prop_Dead$REP<-as.factor(AOV_prop_Dead$REP)
#arcsine transforrmation of proportion Dead
AOV_prop_Dead$asn<-asin(sqrt(AOV_prop_Dead$prop_Dead))
#adding descriptive treatment name
AOV_prop_Dead$Treatment<-ifelse(AOV_prop_Dead$TRT=="A",
                            "Red Alder 10 years",
                            ifelse(AOV_prop_Dead$TRT=="B",
                               "Cottonwood 10 years", "Immediate Douglas fir"))
#creating stand means
AOV_BA_stand_mean<- stand_ABC %>% group_by(TRT, DF_age)%>%summarise( N = sum(!is.na(Live_BA_mpha)),BA=mean(Live_BA_mpha, na.rm=TRUE), sd = sd(Live_BA_mpha, na.rm=TRUE),se = sd / sqrt(N))
AOV_BA_stand_mean$age<-as.numeric(AOV_BA_stand_mean$DF_age)
#adding descriptive treatment name
AOV_BA_stand_mean$Treatment<-ifelse(AOV_BA_stand_mean$TRT=="A",
                            "Red Alder 10 years",
                            ifelse(AOV_BA_stand_mean$TRT=="B",
                               "Cottonwood 10 years", "Immediate Douglas fir"))
AOV_BA_stand_mean$lower<-AOV_BA_stand_mean$BA-AOV_BA_stand_mean$se
AOV_BA_stand_mean$upper<-AOV_BA_stand_mean$BA+AOV_BA_stand_mean$se
#RUN ANOVA
```
